verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports agents obtaining their own API keys autonomously (agent-signup, CLI init) and self-hosted deployments offer per-user API keys and audit logs, and entity-scoped memory can isolate data by user/agent/app. However, there is no evidence of true least-privilege scoping (e.g., read-only vs write-only keys, permission tiers, or role-based access control) for API credentials themselves — the entity scoping is about memory partitioning, not credential permissions. Missing for 10: documented permission levels/scopes on API keys, ability to restrict an agent's key to specific actions or memory subsets, and any audit/reporting on credential privilege boundaries.
